Sign catalogue

Sign

M86

Looks like: one long vertical stroke

Adapted from the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 144). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W031 · Unclassified

Appears in 132 texts (149 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W031 is in 216 texts, including at Dholavira.

Where it appears 132

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 148 objects in all carry it.
